description: NaPb₂O₆I is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent IO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-25°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.34 Å. Pb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.69 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Pb, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pb, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Pb, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.89 Å. I is bonded to six O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-25°.
